name: Data Analyzer: Data with out-of-range and blank values is reported with the right issue types
objective: Shows that the main data check finds range violations and missing values and returns a report in the agreed layout, including the issue-count fields added for long issue lists.
precondition: Server application (the API) loaded in the offline test harness, with no network and no AI model, and with a made-up API key configured. Requests carry the correct key unless stated.

steps.action: Upload the made-up data file together with rules: age between 0 and 120, gender allowed values 1, 2, 3.
steps.data: Made-up 5-row data file (columns record_id, age, gender, weight_kg) with deliberate errors: ages 150 and -5, gender 4 and one blank gender.
steps.expected: HTTP 200. The report has exactly eight parts, no more and no fewer: summary, issues, recommendations, quality_checks, summary_stats, issues_total, issues_returned and issues_truncated (the last three say how many issues were found, how many are listed, and whether the list was cut short).

steps.action: Read the summary counts.
steps.expected: total_rows is 5, total_columns is 4 and issues_found is at least 2.

steps.action: Read the individual issues.
steps.expected: Issue types include range_violation and missing_values, and every issue has a severity of error, warning or info plus a message.
